en.headline: Government and MTR sign Northern Link agreement as cost falls to HK$86.2 billion
en.dek: The full main and spur lines are targeted to open by 2034 after the Executive Council approved the second-phase financial arrangements, 28 per cent below earlier estimates.
body: The Transport and Logistics Bureau and the MTR Corporation signed a project agreement on Tuesday for the full Northern Link, covering both the main line and spur line, after the Executive Council approved the financial arrangements for the second phase.

Officials said the verified construction cost for the entire project stands at about HK$86.2 billion in July 2025 prices, 28 per cent lower than earlier estimates. The second phase, covering tunnels, stations, a depot and electromechanical systems, is estimated at HK$54.8 billion.

The main line will be a 10.7-kilometre underground railway with five stations, linking the Tuen Ma Line at Kam Sheung Road to the East Rail Line at Kwu Tung, with intermediate stations at San Tin, Ngau Tam Mei and Au Tau. The spur line will connect to Huanggang Port.

Under a railway-plus-property model, the government will grant MTR eight sites for residential and commercial development, with a fixed sum deducted from the land premium to help fund the second phase. The full line is targeted to open simultaneously by 2034 or earlier.

zh.headline: 政府與港鐵簽署北環線全線協議 建造成本降至862億元
zh.dek: 行政長官會同行政會議批准第二部分財務安排後，主線及支線目標於2034年或之前同步開通，整體造價較原先估計低28%。
body: 運輸及物流局與港鐵公司周二簽署北環線全線項目協議，涵蓋主線及支線，標誌項目全面進入建設階段。行政長官會同行政會議同日批准第二部分的財務安排。
政府表示，經獨立審核後，整個項目建造成本預算約為862億港元（按2025年7月價格計算），較原先估計低28%。第二部分涵蓋隧道、車站、車廠及機電系統，預算約548億元。
主線為長10.7公里的地下鐵路，設五個車站，於錦上路站連接屯馬線、古洞站連接東鐵線，中途站包括新田、牛潭尾及凹頭。支線將連接皇崗口岸。
政府採用「鐵路加物業」模式向港鐵批出八幅用地作住宅及商業發展，並從地價中扣除固定總額資助第二部分工程。全線目標於2034年或之前同步開通。
